import Route types.description:
Generated per-route types. Run `react-router typegen` (or start the dev server) to produce `./+types/<route>`.
The file name must match the route module's own file name.

Route.ComponentProps.description: Props the route's default export receives. Everything is typed from this route's own loader and action.

Route.LoaderArgs.description: Arguments to a server `loader`. `params` is typed from the route's path segments.

Route.ClientLoaderArgs.description: Arguments to a `clientLoader`. `serverLoader()` fetches this route's server loader data.

Route.ActionArgs.description: Arguments to a server `action`. Read the submission with `await request.formData()`.

Route.ClientActionArgs.description: Arguments to a `clientAction`. `serverAction()` delegates to this route's server action.

Route.MetaArgs.description: Arguments to `meta`. In React Router v8 `data` is replaced by `loaderData`.

Route.ErrorBoundaryProps.description: Props an `ErrorBoundary` export receives. `error` is `unknown` — narrow it with `isRouteErrorResponse`.
